output.summary: The grant's $400,000 valuation at $1.00/share for 400,000 shares meets the $280,000/4-year ($70,000/yr) equity floor. At the 409A common stock value of $0.82/share, the actual grant value is $328,000, still exceeding the $280,000 minimum. The 0.40% ownership (400,000/100M shares) ensures positive payout value in a $100M exit since 0.40% of $100M is $400,000, well above the $280,000 total required.
